_README: Edit the wording below to change the ballot email + SMS members receive. NO code change or redeploy of the tools is needed — send_codes.py / resend.py read this file at send time. Keep the placeholders: emails use %recipient.link% (and optional %recipient.name%); the SMS uses {link} (and optional {name}). An env var (BALLOT_SUBJECT / BALLOT_EMAIL_TEXT / BALLOT_EMAIL_HTML / BALLOT_SMS_BODY) overrides the matching field here for a one-off send. Point BALLOT_TEMPLATES at a different file to swap the whole set (e.g. per language).
email_subject: Your DSA ballot is ready — vote now
email_text:
Hello,

Your ballot for the DSA election is ready. Vote securely here — this link is unique to you, do not share it:

%recipient.link%

Voting is quick and your ballot is confidential. If you have questions, contact your chapter's elections committee.

In solidarity,
DSA Elections
